description: H200 promotion screen for record A 006: r54's config (A 005's recipe plus an entropy floor, coef 0.05 below entropy 0.1) with keep_best_dev on (RULES v3.4, PLAN A8): the run ends on the weights of its best in-loop dev eval, and its evals and weight copies count on the clock. The training path is r54's, so the last eval is what r54 would have reported; both are logged. 3-seed rule on the kept eval's dev: every seed >= 0.305, which is the line 0.285 (A 004's dev mean 0.255 + 0.03) plus 0.02 because the best of eight evals reads about 0.01-0.02 high, and none collapsed. Otherwise seeds 3-4 and the five-seed form.
